subject.title: fix: bind Azure cleanup to exact durable claims

question: Should this PR intentionally reject legacy or missing Azure local claims before direct Azure release and cleanup delete resources?
rationale: The security fix is coherent, but it changes upgrade behavior for existing Azure leases whose local claims lack the new provider scope or immutable VM identity fields.

options.title: Accept fail-closed Azure claims
options.body: Merge after CI if maintainers agree that destructive Azure cleanup must reject legacy or missing exact claims by default.

options.title: Add reclaim guidance first
options.body: Require a documented operator reclaim or adoption path before merge so intentional lost-local-state recovery is clear.

options.title: Pause for broader policy
options.body: Hold the PR until Azure cleanup, release, and legacy-claim behavior are decided alongside other provider cleanup policies.
